clips.text: Yes, there is a way: but in many the will is lacking to find it.
And it is not far away, it is just by the corner, so to speak.
Knowingly or unknowingly all men long for it.
Really, the whole of life is a longing for it because without it there is no reaching, no flowering, no fulfillment.
But few men seek it and still fewer seek it rightly and still fewer find it - and all of those who find it do not enter.
Only a few enter and still fewer progressively follow it.
But those who follow it with their total being realize that the way is the goal itself!
